name: ai-ready
description: Audit codebases for AI-readiness using a 7-category 100-point rubric, then apply ROI-prioritized improvements (CLAUDE.md scaffolds, ANTIPATTERNS.md seeds, INDEX.md, ARCHITECTURE.md Mermaid diagrams, freshness Stop hook, trend sparkline). Multi-module and single-module (package-as-module) layouts are scored on parallel rubrics. v0.2.0+: optional .ai-ready/config.json drives frontmatter-aware INDEX grouping and preserves user-edited lazy-load triggers. v0.3.0+: the config.json rubric section makes scoring respect project reality — a consolidated decision dir (docs/design) counts as ADR, code-gen deps (springdoc) count as API contracts, and project-level .claude/settings.json lint/test hooks count as a verification gate. v0.4.0+: apply guards human-adopted docs — generators refuse to overwrite a file that lacks the auto-generated signature (--force to override), and apply runs a per-doc diff-confirm loop instead of blind overwrite. v0.4.2+: INDEX generation respects .gitignore — inside a git repo only tracked or unignored .md files are indexed, so generated artifacts (http API docs) and local-only files (.claude/commands) no longer pollute INDEX; non-git directories fall back to the full walk. v0.5.0+: apply maintains docs surgically — the doc-touching scripts (gen_index, gen_arch_diagram, extract_section, inject_module_map, inject_lazy_load_index) gain a --json facts-only mode (read-only), and the AI adds new entries and updates changed ones while preserving human curation (groups, ordering, prose) instead of mechanically overwriting whole docs. v0.6.0+: the loop-engine is folded in as part of this single plugin — the autonomous maker→checker→deterministic-rubric verification loop (skills /loop-run, /loop-review, /loop-lessons + agents loop-checker, loop-lesson-synthesizer + the _loop-engine scoring shell) ships alongside audit/apply, so installing ai-ready brings the whole audit→apply→verify cycle. The loop reads the docs/ANTIPATTERNS.md that ai-ready writes as its knowledge layer and appends caught mistakes back to it (same AI-additive append, no wholesale overwrite). Build/test/lint commands, ticket pattern and base branch are runtime-detected (detect_build.py), so no adapter file is persisted; only an optional project-local .loop/rubric.md is merged over the engine BASE rubric.
